- Work in the django/django checkout at /testbed and resolve a GitHub issue by editing the repository's source files.
- Issue: moving a field onto a new model subclass in a single migration step. Starting model:
  ```python
  class Readable(models.Model):
      title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
  ```
  changed to:
  ```python
  class Readable(models.Model):
      pass

  class Book(Readable):
      title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
  ```

The issue asks that the autodetector be able to produce the working order.
